findings.summary: The player falls at the same ledge gap four times before clearing it.

telemetry: 4× death (fall) in ledge between 18.4 s and 58.2 s
evidence.visual: Each attempt falls just short of the far platform.

findings.suggested_fix: Narrow the gap or add a visible landing lip on the far side.

highlight.prompt: the gap between the two ledges

findings.summary: The player can't find the beacon and wanders the plaza for almost 90 seconds.

quotes.text: Where am I going? What beacon?

telemetry: 88 s between zone_enter plaza and zone_enter hall
evidence.visual: The beacon over the door is the same colour as the wall behind it.

findings.suggested_fix: Give the beacon a contrasting colour and an emissive glow.

findings.summary: The objective 'Find a way through.' doesn't point to the switch; the player tries the gate repeatedly.

telemetry: 89 s between objective 'Find a way through.' and the gate opening
evidence.visual: The player walks into the closed gate three times before climbing to the balcony.

findings.suggested_fix: Change the objective to name the red switch on the balcony.

highlight.prompt: the red switch on the balcony

findings.summary: The enemy hits the player within two seconds of landing from the drop, twice.

evidence.visual: The enemy charges as soon as the player lands.

findings.suggested_fix: Delay the enemy's charge by about 2 seconds after the player lands.

findings.summary: The EXIT sign sends the player into the left dead end, and they have to backtrack.

quotes.text: The sign said exit... dead end?

telemetry: zone_enter fork_left 305.1 s, back in fork at 322.1 s
evidence.visual: The arrow on the sign points left.

findings.suggested_fix: Point the EXIT arrow to the right branch.

findings.summary: The camera clips into the plaza wall when the player backs into a corner.

evidence.visual: The view is briefly filled by the wall texture.
